description: A required field is empty, whitespace only, or absent after parsing.
rationale: A supervisory report with no identifier, name, date or period cannot be attributed to an institution or placed in time.

description: institution_id does not match the expected identifier pattern.
rationale: Identifiers are issued by the supervisor. A value that does not follow the issued pattern is a submission error, not a new institution.

description: institution_id is not present in the supervised institution register.
rationale: Reporting from an institution the supervisor does not recognise cannot be supervised or aggregated into sector totals.

description: reporting_date is not a valid calendar date.
rationale: The date anchors the report in time. An unparseable date silently becomes a missing date once parsed.

description: reporting_date falls outside the window of the stated reporting period.
rationale: A report dated outside its own period cannot be reconciled with the period it claims to cover.

description: reporting_period does not match the expected YYYY-MM pattern.
rationale: The period is the aggregation key for every downstream indicator, so it has to be a well formed period.

description: reporting_period does not agree with the month of reporting_date.
rationale: The month in reporting_period and the month in reporting_date are two statements of the same fact. When they disagree, the record would be counted twice or in the wrong period.

description: total_deposits was supplied but cannot be read as a number.
rationale: Text such as 'not-reported' is a missing value wearing a disguise. Coercing it to zero would understate sector deposits.

description: total_loans was supplied but cannot be read as a number.
rationale: The same reasoning as R008, applied to loans and advances.
A negative deposit balance is not economically meaningful for the reported measure and signals an extraction or sign error.
A negative loan balance is not economically meaningful for the reported measure and signals an extraction or sign error.

description: A financial amount exceeds the configured plausibility ceiling.
rationale: Magnitude ceilings catch unit errors, such as a value reported in shillings instead of Tanzanian shillings.

description: The submitted row is identical to a row already received.
rationale: Exact duplicates inflate totals. They are separated from resubmissions because no judgement is needed to detect them.

description: Another row was received for the same institution and reporting period.
rationale: Two different values for one institution and period is a resubmission or an amendment. Which one is authoritative cannot be decided from the file alone, so a supervisor has to confirm it.

description: reporting_period is not present in the reporting calendar.
rationale: The calendar defines which periods exist and when they close. A period that is not on the calendar cannot be aggregated.

description: Loans divided by deposits is outside the expected band.
rationale: The ratio is a supervisory indicator. An implausible ratio is not proof of a bad submission, so it is flagged for review rather than discarded.
A zero balance is legal but unusual for an operating institution and often means the figure was not supplied.

description: The reporting institution is on the enhanced monitoring list.
rationale: The report is valid, but a supervisor should see it alongside the institution's watchlist status.

description: The reporting period is finer than the institution's reporting cadence.
rationale: A quarterly institution reporting a monthly period is either a template error or an early submission, and needs confirmation.
